title: Checks for while loops comparing floating point values.
summary: If you increment floating point values, errors can compound, so, use integers instead if possible. Clippy puts this lint in the nursery group, at the level allow.

title: Checks whether variables used within while loop condition can be (and are) mutated in the body.
summary: If the condition is unchanged, entering the body of the loop will lead to an infinite loop. Clippy puts this lint in the correctness group, at the level deny.

title: Detects loop + match combinations that are easier written as a while let loop.
summary: The while let loop is usually shorter and more readable. Clippy puts this lint in the complexity group, at the level warn.

title: Checks for while let expressions on iterators.
summary: Readability. A simple for loop is shorter and conveys the intent better. Clippy puts this lint in the style group, at the level warn.
